# React Bits Dither attribution

The original web implementation is preserved in `Dither.jsx` and was fetched
from commit `e12c22192ac7b4b452c5e2feb9b586d74765d696` of
https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits.

React Bits is released under the MIT + Commons Clause License Condition v1.0; see LICENSE. The AppKit/Metal implementation
in `Sources/DitherScreenSaverView.swift` is a native translation of its wave-field
and dither-pass algorithm. Web-only `className` and `style` props are not
applicable to this screen saver.
